newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on options-related buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on options-related buying.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Friday, lifted by options-related buying, traders said.
"There was a lot of options trading today," a pit source said. "Some small delta trading reflected prices substantially higher than the board and that brought some better bids into the pit."
Strength also came from the cash market. One cash-connected trader said farmers were paid $12 per cwt this week in parts of eastern Arkansas.
New crop contracts drew strength from continued concerns about cool weather in key growing regions.
"The rice crop is being plagued by very cool nighttime temperatures," a trader said. "This crop needs heat."
Rice futures ended nine to one cent per cwt higher with July up nine at $11.61.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 150 lots, below 191 on Thursday. Options volume was pegged at 300 lots.
